1015-the-oregon-trail-sketches-of-prairi.title: The Oregon Trail Sketches Of Prairie And Rocky Mountain Life
1015-the-oregon-trail-sketches-of-prairi.creator: Francis Parkman, Jr.
1015-the-oregon-trail-sketches-of-prairi.description: A book by Francis Parkman, Jr.. ents and provisions of a party of Oregon emigrants, a band of mules and horses, piles of saddles and harness, and a multitude of nondescript articles, indispensable on the prairies. Almost hidden in this medley one might have seen a small French cart, of the sort very appropriately called a “mule-killer”  beyond the frontiers, and not far distant a tent, together with a miscellaneous assortment of boxes and barrels.

arxiv-2105-08346.title: Identification robust inference for moments based analysis of linear dynamic panel data models
arxiv-2105-08346.creator: Maurice J.G. Bun, Frank Kleibergen
arxiv-2105-08346.description: Abstract We use identification robust tests to show that difference, level and non-linear moment conditions, as proposed by Arellano and Bond (1991), Arellano and Bover (1995), Blundell and Bond (1998) and Ahn and Schmidt (1995) for the linear dynamic panel data model, do not separately identify the autoregressive parameter when its true value is close to one and the variance

arxiv-2206-07206.title: Manifolds without real projective or flat conformal structures
arxiv-2206-07206.creator: Lorenzo Ruffoni
arxiv-2206-07206.description: Abstract . In any dimension at least five we construct examples of closed smooth manifolds with the following properties: 1) they have neither real projective nor flat conformal structures; 2) their fundamental group is a non-elementary Gromov hyperbolic group. These examples are obtained via relative strict hyperbolization. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 57N16, 20F67, 53C23 1.

arxiv-2211-06797.title: Perceptual Video Coding for Machines via Satisfied Machine Ratio Modeling
arxiv-2211-06797.creator: Qi Zhang, Shanshe Wang, Xinfeng Zhang, Chuanmin Jia, Zhao Wang, Siwei Ma, and Wen Gao
arxiv-2211-06797.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Qi Zhang, Shanshe Wang, Xinfeng Zhang, Chuanmin Jia, Zhao Wang, Siwei Ma, and Wen Gao. Video Coding for Machines (VCM) aims to compress visual signals for machine analysis. However, existing methods only consider a few machines, neglecting the majority. Moreover, the machine’s perceptual characteristics are not leveraged effectively, resulting in suboptimal compression efficiency.

arxiv-2302-06433.title: Label-efficient Time Series Representation Learning: A Review
arxiv-2302-06433.creator: Emadeldeen Eldele, Mohamed Ragab, Zhenghua Chen, Min Wu, Chee-Keong Kwoh, and Xiaoli Li
arxiv-2302-06433.description: Abstract Label-efficient time series representation learning, which aims to learn effective representations with limited labeled data, is crucial for deploying deep learning models in real-world applications. To address the scarcity of labeled time series data, various strategies, e.g., transfer learning, self-supervised learning, and semi-supervised learning, have been developed.

arxiv-2310-19209.title: Parametric factorization of non linear second order differential equations
arxiv-2310-19209.creator: Gabriel González
arxiv-2310-19209.description: Abstract In this paper the factorization method introduced by Rosu & Cornejo-Pérez for second order non linear differential equations is generalized by adding a parameter in order to obtain the general solutions for the mixed quadratic and linear Liénard type equation. The new parametric factorization is used to obtain complete analytic solutions for nonlinear second order differential equations.

arxiv-2402-03918.title: Dynastic Potential Crossover Operator
arxiv-2402-03918.creator:
ame Francisco Chicano \addr chicano@lcc.uma.es, 
ame Gabriela Ochoa \addr gabriela.ochoa@cs.stir.ac.uk, 
ame L. Darrell Whitley \addr whitley@cs.colostate.edu, 
ame Renato Tinós \addr rtinos@ffclrp.usp.br
arxiv-2402-03918.description: Abstract An optimal recombination operator for two parent solutions provides the best solution among those that take the value for each variable from one of the parents (gene transmission property). If the solutions are bit strings, the offspring of an optimal recombination operator is optimal in the smallest hyperplane containing the two parent solutions.

arxiv-2402-16596.title: Tracking Semantic Change in Slovene: A Novel Dataset and Optimal Transport-Based Distance
arxiv-2402-16596.creator: Marko Pranjić, Kaja Dobrovoljc, Senja Pollak, Matej Martinc
arxiv-2402-16596.description: Abstract In this paper, we focus on the detection of semantic changes in Slovene, a less resourced Slavic language with two million speakers. Detecting and tracking semantic changes provides insight into the evolution of language caused by changes in society and culture.

arxiv-2408-05983.title: Drift wave solitons and zonal flows: implication on staircase formation
arxiv-2408-05983.creator: Ningfei Chen 1,2 , Liu Chen 2,3 , Fulvio Zonca 2,3 and Zhiyong Qiu 1,3
arxiv-2408-05983.description: Abstract The self-consistent nonlinear interaction of drift wave (DW) and zonal flow (ZF) is investigated using nonlinear gyrokinetic theory, with both spontaneous excitation and beat-driven of ZF by DW treated on the same footing. DW solitons are formed in the nonlinear DW-ZF interactions and are confined between radially spaced micro-barriers.

arxiv-2512-07848.title: RaX-Crash: A Resource Efficient and Explainable Small Model Pipeline with an Application to City Scale Injury Severity Prediction
arxiv-2512-07848.creator: Di Zhu 1 , Chen Xie 2 , Ziwei Wang 3 , Haoyun Zhang 4
arxiv-2512-07848.description: Abstract New York City reports over one hundred thousand motor vehicle collisions each year, creating substantial injury and public health burden. We present RaX-Crash, a resource efficient and explainable small model pipeline for structured injury severity prediction on the official NYC Motor Vehicle Collisions dataset.

doe-osti-3018055-compositing-and-charact.title: Compositing and Characterization of SE Quadrant Waste Exemplars
doe-osti-3018055-compositing-and-charact.creator: Daniel, Richard C., Burns, Carolyn A., Westesen, Amy M. et al.
doe-osti-3018055-compositing-and-charact.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. This report outlines the experimental investigation and characterization of transport properties in Hanford SE quadrant High-Level Waste (HLW). The goal of the study was to establish baseline behaviors of bulk composite rheology and settling characteristics to facilitate waste tr

pmc-10654240.title: Dopamine as a polymerizable reagent for enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay using horseradish peroxidase
pmc-10654240.creator: Sumed Yadoung, Shinichi Shimizu, Surat Hongsibsong, Koji Nakano, Ryoichi Ishimatsu
pmc-10654240.description: We demonstrate that dopamine can be used as a reagent for colorimetric enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) using horseradish peroxidase (HRP). Dopamine was able to be polymerized in the presence of HRP and H2O2, and black polydopamine was obtained after the enzymatic reaction.

pmc-10749494.title: SNHG1/miR‐21 axis mediates the cardioprotective role of aloin in sepsis through modulating cardiac cell viability and inflammatory responses
pmc-10749494.creator: Jin Peng, Shuyuan Li, Maozhi Han, Feng Gao, Lujun Qiao, Yonggang Tian
pmc-10749494.description: BackgroundAloin has cardioprotective effects, however, its cardioprotective role in sepsis remains unclear. This study aimed to analyze whether aloin could prevent sepsis‐related myocardial damage and explore the underlying mechanisms by examining the expression of long‐noncoding RNA (lncRNA) SNHG1 and microRNA‐21 (miR‐21).MethodsThe interaction of SNHG1 with miR‐21 was identified by dual‐luciferase reporter assay.

pmc-11360366.title: Redox-Driven Formation of Mn(III) in Ice
pmc-11360366.creator: Tao Chen, Tra My Bui Thi, Tao Luo, Wei Cheng, Khalil Hanna, Jean-François Boily
pmc-11360366.description: Redox-driven reactions involving Mn(II) species adsorbed at Mn(IV) oxide surfaces can release Mn(III) in the form of dissolved Mn(III)–ligand species in natural waters. Using pyrophosphate (PP) as a model ligand, we show that freezing accelerates and enhances Mn(III) formation in the form of Mn(III)–PP complexes.

pmc-11396060.title: Assessment of adeno-associated virus purity by capillary electrophoresis-based western
pmc-11396060.creator: Julyana Acevedo, Yiling Bi, Jessica Gee, Santoshkumar L. Khatwani
pmc-11396060.description: A rigorous analytical assessment of recombinant adeno-associated virus (rAAV)-based drug products is critical for their successful development as clinical candidates. It is especially important to ascertain high purity while simultaneously ensuring low levels of impurities in the final drug product.

pmc-11453008.title: The supplementation of l-carnitine in critically ill patients with sepsis: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-11453008.creator: Chang Meng, Yudan Ma, Ning Fu, Jie Li, Biao Sun, Zhichao Li, Qing Wang, Peng Liu
pmc-11453008.description: ObjectivesThe evidence suggests that l-carnitine may reduce mortality in critically ill patients with sepsis. However, the conclusions of different studies are inconsistent. A meta-analysis was conducted to evaluate the effect of l-carnitine compliance on mortality in patients with sepsis.MethodsA search of the PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane Library databases was conducted on 1 June 2024.

pmc-11462567.title: Investigating Lasofoxifene Efficacy Against the Y537S + F404V Double-Mutant Estrogen Receptor Alpha Using Molecular Dynamics Simulations
pmc-11462567.creator: El Mehdi Bouricha, Mohammed Hakmi
pmc-11462567.description: Estrogen receptor alpha (ERα) plays a critical role in breast cancer (BC) progression, with endocrine therapy being a key treatment for ERα + BC. However, resistance often arises due to somatic mutations in the ERα ligand-binding domain (LBD). Lasofoxifene, a third-generation selective estrogen receptor modulator, has shown promise against Y537S and D538G mutations.

pmc-11546445.title: Development of a novel light-sensitive PPG model using PPG scalograms and PPG-NET learning for non-invasive hypertension monitoring
pmc-11546445.creator: Amjed Al Fahoum, Ahmad Al Omari, Ghadeer Al Omari, Ala'a Zyout
pmc-11546445.description: Background and objectivePhotoplethysmography (PPG) signals provide a non-invasive method for monitoring cardiovascular health, including blood pressure levels, which are critical for the early detection and management of hypertension. This study leverages wavelet transformation and special purpose deep learning model, enhanced by signal processing and normalization, to classify blood pressure stages from PPG signals.

pmc-11603906.title: Genomic characteristics of Vibrio vulnificus strains isolated from clinical and environmental sources
pmc-11603906.creator: Jinkyeong Lee, Jeong-Ih Shin, Woo Young Cho, Kun Taek Park, Yeun-Jun Chung, Seung-Hyun Jung
pmc-11603906.description: Vibrio vulnificus, a gram-negative pathogenic bacterium, transmitted via undercooked seafood or contaminated seawater, causes septicemia and wound infections. In this study, we analyzed 15 clinical and 11 environmental isolates. In total, 20 sequence types (STs), including eight novel STs, were identified. Antibiotic resistance gene analysis commonly detected the cyclic AMP receptor protein (CRP) in both the clinical and environmental isolates.

pmc-12495041.title: Whole-genome sequencing data of Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Enteritidis strain SSTRA25 isolated from a pediatric bacteremia case in Mosul, Iraq
pmc-12495041.creator: Shymaa F. Yonis, Sura I. Khudher, Talal S. Salih, Rayan M. Faisal, Ayman M. Khaleel
pmc-12495041.description: Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Enteritidis is a well-known non-typhoidal serovar, commonly associated with foodborne illnesses. Here, we report the draft genome sequence of Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Enteritidis strain SSTRA25, isolated from a pediatric patient with bacteremia in Mosul, Iraq. The genome was sequenced using the Illumina NovaSeq 6000 platform.

pmc-13121530.title: Dynamic changes of monocytes-related immune activation in people with HIV switching to long-acting injectable cabotegravir plus rilpivirine
pmc-13121530.creator: Maria Antonella Zingaropoli, Mariasilvia Guardiani, Anna Carraro, Eeva Tortellini, Federica Dominelli, Michele Antonacci, Cosmo Del Borgo, Raffaella Marocco, Giulia Mancarella, Lorenzo Ansaldo, Piergiorgio Pace, Livia Bresciani, Serena Vita, Fabio Mengoni, Roberta Campagna, Ombretta Turriziani, Mari
pmc-13121530.description: The aim of this study was to examine the dynamic changes in monocyte/macrophage- and dendritic cell (DC)-related immune activation in people with HIV (PWH) before switching to long-acting (LA) injectable cabotegravir (CAB) plus rilpivirine (RPV) (T0), after six (T6m) and twelve months (T12m).

pmc-13287881.title: 8: Integrated RNA Sequencing, Whole-Genome Sequencing, and Spatial Profiling Reveal Distinct Tumor Microenvironment Architectures Across Anatomical Subtypes of Cholangiocarcinoma
pmc-13287881.creator: Soravis Osataphan, Patrick Foley, Yuling Ma, Athanasios Ploumakis, Antonella Amaral, Juan Jose Vignon Whaley, Mary Linton Peters, Ioannis S Vlachos
pmc-13287881.description: BackgroundCholangiocarcinoma (CCA) encompasses three anatomically and biologically distinct subtypes— intrahepatic (iCCA), perihilar (pCCA), and distal (dCCA)—each with unique clinicopathological features, genomic landscapes and therapeutic vulnerabilities. We hypothesized that these subtypes harbor distinct tumor microenvironment (TME) architectures shaped by both shared and subtype specific genomic features.

pmc-13366032.title: IFPHPOS0015 ‘The Future Isn’t Bright for Women’: Women’s Experiences and Perceptions of Health Inequalities in the North of England
pmc-13366032.creator: Olivia Engle
pmc-13366032.description: BackgroundWakefield in the United Kingdom has a female healthy life expectancy (HLE) rate that is 6.1 years less than the England average and has been declining since 2011. Health Equity North (2024) identified reported health status, long-term conditions, and the menopause as possible causes of inequalities between northern and southern women.
